mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNLEADERSCHDUL ( SCHDUL_ID, SCHDUL_SE, SCHDUL_NM, SCHDUL_CN, SCHDUL_PLACE, LEADER_ID, REPTIT_SE_CODE, SCHDUL_BGNDE, SCHDUL_ENDDE, SCHDUL_CHARGER_ID, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, CAL_ID ) VALUES ( #{schdulId}, #{schdulSe}, #{schdulNm}, #{schdulCn}, #{schdulPlace}, #{leaderId}, #{reptitSeCode}, #{schdulBgnde}, #{schdulEndde}, #{schdulChargerId}, #{frstRegisterId}, #{lastUpdusrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{calId} )
mapper.select: SELECT s.SCHDUL_ID AS "schdul_id", s.SCHDUL_NM AS "title", CASE WHEN s.SCHDUL_BGNDE IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(s.SCHDUL_BGNDE)) = 14 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(s.SCHDUL_BGNDE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE NULL END AS "start_dt", CASE WHEN s.SCHDUL_ENDDE IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(s.SCHDUL_ENDDE)) = 14 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(s.SCHDUL_ENDDE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE NULL END AS "end_dt", s.SCHDUL_PLACE AS "schdul_place", s.SCHDUL_CN AS "schdul_cn", s.CAL_ID AS "calId", c.COLOR AS "color" FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL s JOIN CALENDAR c ON s.CAL_ID = c.CAL_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CALENDAR ( CAL_ID, CAL_NAME, COLOR, NOTE, ADD_DE, POST_DE, OWNER_ID ) VALUES ( #{calId}, #{calName}, #{color}, 'test', SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{ownerId} )
mapper.select: SELECT cal_id, cal_name, color, owner_id FROM CALENDAR ORDER BY cal_name
